newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve refrained from open market operations on Friday, dealers said.
Analysts had expected the Fed to stay out of the market, noting that the central bank added temporary reserves to the banking system on Thursday through 14-day fixed system repurchases.
Also, a Federal funds rate of 5-3/16 percent, lower than the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate, was seen as another indication that the amount of reserves in the banking system was adequate.
-- E. Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679
